title: Tunisian Spiced Couscous Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy bowl filled with the spices of Tunisia, all plant-based and vegan-friendly. A perfect meal for a warm evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Tunisian Spiced Pilaf Mix and cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes, roasted red peppers, and olives. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the couscous is cooked.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
